About WSB Intel

BORN FROM
THE FIELD.

WSB Intel was not built in a boardroom. It was forged through decades of direct field experience — special operations veterans, intelligence analysts, risk consultants, and technical engineers who have operated across conflict zones, secured critical infrastructure, and designed multi-layered defense systems worldwide.

From hostile-environment site surveys to embassy-grade security architecture, our operators have lived the mission. We don't theorize risk — we have neutralized it, and built systems to prevent recurrence.

Every engagement begins with a rigorous strategic assessment, is tailored with technical precision, and concludes with secure, resilient execution. We are the force behind your force.

Operational Services

ELITE SERVICES.

Field-tested. Tactically precise. Our service portfolio spans the full threat lifecycle — from pre-emptive detection to active neutralization and post-incident hardening.

Secure Your Operations
SVC-01 // TRAINING
Training Programs

Expert-led instruction in counterintelligence, surveillance detection, operational security, and crisis response — delivered by verified field professionals, not theorists.

SVC-02 // TSCM
Counter-Surveillance & TSCM

Full-spectrum Technical Surveillance Counter-Measures: RF spectrum analysis, nonlinear junction detection, thermal imaging, and physical inspection to locate and eliminate every class of covert device.

SVC-03 // AUDIT
Security Audits & Risk Assessment

Deep-profile evaluations of physical, technical, and human-vector vulnerabilities. Each engagement delivers a threat matrix, gap analysis, and a prioritized hardening roadmap.

SVC-04 // COMM
Secure Mobile Communications

Encrypted, tamper-resistant platforms. Hardened devices, secure messaging, and end-to-end overlays ensuring high-level conversations remain beyond reach of any third party.

SVC-05 // EP
Executive Protection

Discreet close-protection teams from elite military and law enforcement backgrounds. Counter-surveillance, defensive driving, threat assessment, and emergency response — seamless and without disruption.

SVC-06 // MONITOR
Remote Surveillance Monitoring

24/7 encrypted video and sensor monitoring with human verification teams and AI-assisted analytics. Centralized visibility, instant anomaly escalation, and coordinated response.
